thread:
incident-bot: [PAGER] P1 - Performance advisory: sustained elevated latency and reduced throughput in ap-southeast-1. Trigger: p95 > 700ms for 4m and request queue > 2x baseline. Pager routed to on-call. Link: https://pager.example/inc/1802006789

maya (oncall): Ack. I'm on it. Seeing p95 at ~780ms, p99 ~1.9s. Error profile: 504s and a small jump in 429s. No broad 5xx. Starting quick blast triage.

hank (eng-runtime): Noted. Any heavy batch/embedding jobs or customer spike?

maya (oncall): Correlation: big scheduled nightly evals from internal bench + one customer running large synchronous embedding job. Node telemetry shows uneven GPU utilization: some nodes idle, others pegged; scheduler imbalance suspected. Autoscaler created nodes but new nodes are not warming KV cache, leading to token latency spikes.

maya (oncall): Quick triage summary:
- Region: ap-southeast-1 (primary impact)
- Window: ~02:20 - now UTC
- Metrics: p95=780ms, p99=1.9s, queue 2.3x baseline
- Errors: 504 gateway timeouts rose to 1.2% at peak, 429 up to 1.0%
- Affected: hosted API and some dedicated pools in the region

zed (sre): I'm pulling gateway logs and scheduler traces. If autoscaler created cold nodes, we should either pre-warm KV cache image or route heavy sessions away. Will start log collection.

priya (eng-platform): Preliminary mitigation plan:
1) Divert 30% of new traffic to ap-southeast-2 and us-west-2 (cross-region routing).
2) Apply short-term throttles on embedding endpoints for non-enterprise customers.
3) Rollout pre-warmed image to new nodes (KV snapshot).
4) Spin an emergency canary serving a lower-concurrency, quantized model (gpt-small-q4) for high-latency requests.
5) Update public status and send customer advisories to impacted list.

maya (oncall): Running quick commands and pasting snippets:
```bash
# check node distribution and pod placement
kubectl get nodes -l pool=inference-ap-southeast-1 -o wide
kubectl top pods -n inference --containers | sort -k3 -r | head -n 20
# inspect router rules
curl -sS "https://router.api.internal/v1/routes?region=ap-southeast-1" | jq .
```

hank (eng-runtime): I'm pushing gpt-small-q4 canary (2 pods) and will set router to route 15% of new sessions to it. Canary shows p95 ~160ms so far. I'll increase to 40% if stable.

priya (eng-platform): Applied throttle policy to embeddings for non-enterprise customers: 5 req/min per API-key. Also set emergency route to move 30% of new generation requests to ap-southeast-2.

status-bot: Draft status page message (for review):
"Investigating: We are investigating increased inference latency and reduced throughput impacting ap-southeast-1. Engineers are routing traffic to alternate regions and applying throttles and interim model fallbacks to reduce latency. Some requests may return slower responses or transient timeouts. We will provide updates within 20 minutes."

notify-bot: Customer notification suggestion (concise):
"Hi <Customer>,
Were currently investigating elevated latency and intermittent timeouts for inference requests in our APAC region (ap-southeast-1). To reduce impact we are routing traffic to alternate regions and applying temporary throttles for large batch embedding jobs. You may experience slower responses. Expected improvement within 20	60 minutes; we will send follow-ups.
- Redwood Inference Status Team"

zed (sre): Observed kernel traces: some nodes report high context-switch and GPU driver retries. Collecting /var/log/messages and dmesg for node gpu-22. Uploading to /artifacts/incidents/1802006789/gpu-22.txt

priya (eng-platform): Pre-warm image rollout started; using KV snapshot from snapshot-2026-03-14. Rolling all new nodes with pre-warm setting. ETA ~5m for full rollout.

hank (eng-runtime): Canary at 25% now. Canary metrics show stable latency and no elevated errors. Increasing to 40% and shifting additional sessions.

maya (oncall): mid-mitigation metrics:
- regional p95 (ap-southeast-1) down from 780ms -> 210ms on routed traffic
- overall p95 across APAC ~240ms
- 504s reduced by 85%
- queue length trending to baseline

claire (customer-success): Noted we should proactively email our top 10 enterprise accounts in APAC with a short note and offer to open priority support tickets. I'll prepare the list and copy of the email.

priya (eng-platform): Quick internal comms template for enterprise outreach (editable):
Subject: Temporary increased latency in APAC region (ap-southeast-1)
Body: Hi <CustomerName>,
We detected increased latency and some transient timeouts impacting inference requests in ap-southeast-1 beginning at <time>. We have: applied cross-region routing, pre-warmed new nodes, throttled non-critical batch jobs, and deployed a temporary quantized model fallback. Observed improvements are in progress. If you had material impact and would like SLA consideration, reply or open a support ticket and we will prioritize. We're preparing a detailed post-incident report.
Regards,
Redwood Inference Ops

maya (oncall): Handoff - I'm stepping out for a quick break. @priya please take ownership for next 45m and coordinate the status page messages and customer notifications. I'll remain reachable if paging resumes.

priya (eng-platform): Acknowledged. I'll keep thread updated. Creating postmortem canvas and scheduling a follow-up with runtime and SRE. Action items being created in the incident board.

zed (sre): Collected artifacts: router traces, gateway logs, node dmesg, kube events, autoscaler logs. Uploading bundle to /artifacts/incidents/1802006789/bundle.tar.gz

status-bot: Status page updated -> Mitigating. Message posted.

notify-bot: Sending customer notifications to impacted list. Using enterprise template for top accounts and short alert for general impacted list.

hank (eng-runtime): Follow-up task: add an autoscaler priority for pre-warm images when scheduled load is detected; also add a heuristic to avoid scheduler placement hot-spots (spread pods across nodes more evenly). I'll draft PRs.

priya (eng-platform): Post-mitigation snapshot (current): p95 ap-southeast-1 ~230ms, p99 ~450ms, queue ~1.02x baseline, errors back to baseline. Recommending keep cross-region routing at 20% for 15 minutes, keep embedding throttle in place for 30 minutes.

claire (customer-success): Sent emails to top 10 enterprise APAC accounts, noted support contacts for potential SLA requests.

priya (eng-platform): Action items and owners:
- Postmortem owner: hank + zed. Draft in 48h.
- Runbook updates: priya to add pre-warm autoscaler priority and embedding throttle snippet.
- Customer follow-ups: claire to manage enterprise comms and SLA requests.
- Monitoring: maya/priya to adjust alerts to include cold-node KV hit-rate anomaly.

maya (oncall): Closing pager and marking incident MITIGATING. Leaving thread open for owners. Thanks team. :tada:

incident-bot: Incident 1802006789 status -> MITIGATING. Pager: CLOSED.

priya (eng-platform): Will update status page to Monitoring if metrics stay stable for 20m. Uploading runbook patch to repo and filing PR: repo: infra/runbooks, branch: incident-1802006789-prewarm.

hank (eng-runtime): Pushing initial postmortem outline to the postmortem tracker. Including hypothesis: scheduler imbalance + cold KV caches under bursty multi-tenant workload. Collecting traces to validate.

zed (sre): Note to self: verify autoscaler backoff settings don't delay pre-warm image launches; add unit test for pre-warm startup path.

claire (customer-success): Keeping customers updated; will publish final summary when postmortem is ready.

status-bot: Reminder scheduled: if no regressions in 20m, update to Monitoring.
